changes.old: Low angle shot, on an 1840s Richmond street at midday, one African American man stops walking with an empty household parcel in his hand, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium view in 1840s Richmond at midday: one Black adult man in a plain linen work shirt pauses beside a simple plaster wall and wooden doorway, his worried face turned toward home, soft daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, on an 1840s Washington rail platform, one porter stands beside a closed box waiting to be loaded, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Medium view on an 1840s Washington wooden rail platform: one porter rests a hand on a tightly shut wooden plank crate. Its solid lid lies flat, nailed flush along all four edges, in soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Close shot, in an 1840s Northern meeting hall, an empty lectern faces a closed doorway; no people are present, muted interior light.
changes.new: Medium view inside an 1840s Northern meeting room: one anonymous adult listener sits on a wooden bench, looking toward an unoccupied wooden lectern beside a closed door, muted window light.

changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street before departure, one Black adult man pauses beside a closed unlettered wooden freight box and looks toward the road north, hazy morning light.
changes.new: Medium view inside an 1840s Richmond room before departure: one Black adult man with dark brown skin rests his hand on a shut rough wooden plank box beside a plain plaster wall, quiet morning window light.
